messages.author: 04e62c3b36bb17bf
messages.subject: Saving scanone permutation peak positions
parts:
Hi Karl et al. 
I am working to implement a custom hotspot analysis - to do this, I need to run permutations, saving the all of the scanone results. Is it possible to extract these data from scanoneperm, or should I manually permute the phenotypes relative to the genotypes?
Thanks,
John

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Saving scanone permutation peak positions
parts:
Yes, you'll need to do this separately.

The usual use of n.perm in scanone will return just the genome-wide maximum LOD for each replicate.

karl
